LESSON: GRAFTING IN PLANTS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Production Techniques
Topic 4.1: Grafting in Plants

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grafting in Plants. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Grafting in Plants
2. Give Kenyan examples for Grafting in Plants
3. Practise Grafting in Plants at school and at home

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAFTING IN PLANTS
This lesson teaches Grafting in Plants for Grade 9 AGRICULTURE.

STUDY STEPS
1. Explain the main ideas in Grafting in Plants
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. Give Kenyan examples for Grafting in Plants
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. Practise Grafting in Plants at school and at home
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Grafting in Plants using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grafting in Plants above.
2. Explain Grafting in Plants to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grafting in Plants.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grafting in Plants with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Grafting in Plants important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Grafting in Plants
2. Give Kenyan examples for Grafting in Plants
3. Practise Grafting in Plants at school and at home

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
